notes: Client cards from VALD machine tests only (no manual tests). Five scored stats and one locked slot. Change numbers here, not in machineCard.js.

never_scored.single_leg_stand: VALD has no HumanTrak norms for Single Leg Stand

symmetry.approved_note: Approved by Peak Performance for client cards (2026-10). VALD prints no asymmetry band, so this scale is ours.
symmetry.label: Peak Performance scale (VALD gives no band for left/right differences)
symmetry.basis: Limb symmetry index (LSI) per lower-body Dynamo test (hips, knees) = weaker side / stronger side x 100, scored on the card scale, then averaged across the battery's lower-body Dynamo tests with both sides. Arm tests are shown as playing arm vs other arm, not scored. LSI 90 (10% asymmetry) is the common return-to-sport strength criterion; beyond 15% asymmetry is associated with injury and poorer performance.
references: Grindem H, Snyder-Mackler L, Moksnes H, Engebretsen L, Risberg MA. Simple decision rules can reduce reinjury risk by 84% after ACL reconstruction: the Delaware-Oslo ACL cohort study. Br J Sports Med. 2016;50(13):804-808.
